dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: "Welcome to the Veluriyam Mirage. I hope you can relax and enjoy some respite from your tiring journey."

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: That's how I would have greeted you if things had been different... *sigh* It's hard to believe how much has happened.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Since everything's fixed now, I thought... Better late than never. What do you think? Pretty professional, huh?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Uh... do you want me to explain the underlying theory? I don't actually know that much about it. In short, a Preprint is like an idea...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Think of it like how a plant should grow is imprinted in its seed, or how a bird will spread its wings is determined while it's still in its egg.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Things follow these instincts and rules that are programmed into them and become that which we see around us. Perhaps the blueprints of all things were created at the very beginning.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: A Preprint is like those blueprints, and the light reflected through the bottle transforms them into the entire Veluriyam Mirage. Ah, but this kind of magic only works within the confines of the bottle.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Oh, are you wondering why we fled Fontaine? It feels like it happened a lifetime ago...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: The reason for our flight... it would be the "water". The waters of Fontaine changed, and to the Oceanids, now the waters there are full of... pain and hatred...?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: For us, if we wanted to live, fleeing was the best choice. Oh, it was then that became lost and fainted in the desert...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: I must say, this desert is really just too vast!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Huh, Rhodeia? Have you met her?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Looks like she finally found a place for herself... Qingce Village? Is that in Liyue? You really have gone far away, Rhodeia...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Yeah, I will... I will work hard! And please do enjoy the humid environment here. You'll rarely come across such a place in the desert!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We found a pocket watch! Look! Is this the legendary Mora Pocketwatch!?

choices.text: It's gold and shiny on the outside!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Hmm, let me take a look...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Y-You really found it!? Is this ordained by destiny?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: The ultimate prize left by the mysterious adventurer was found by the legendary Traveler...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: I sense some sort of... spiritual legacy!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon is really happy to be praised like that, but Paimon is more curious about what happens next...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: N-Nothing like that...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Actually, it never occurred to me that someone would find this pocket watch... After all, even I forgot where it was buried.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: But it's valuable on its own, right? Right!? Additional rewards from me are unnecessary...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Anyway, I'll be writing this down, with just the right amount of flair, of course. I'll transform it into an exciting and thrilling story for my future guests.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Now, the treasure you buried will be replacing this Mora Pocketwatch!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, that's right! We talked about that too, it's about the stories hidden inside the treasure.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Anyway, let's study this watch a little longer, {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Idyia, please write a really exciting story about us!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Don't worry, leave it to me!

choices.text: Will it trigger a hidden event?
It has Mora engraved on it!

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two. What is it? You look like you have questions.

dialogues.speaker: Idyia
dialogues.text: If it's answers about Veluriyam Mirage that you seek, then you've come to the right person. I know Veluriyam Mirage like the ripples on my palm.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: It's just a metaphor! I'd never have any wrinkles, never!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, let Paimon bring you up to speed! We found this letter in the park!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Idyia, you must know where this came from, right?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Of course, it's obviously from... Huh? It's my first time seeing such a letter...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The ripples on your palm aren't looking too clear now...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: S-Someone must have buried it while I wasn't paying attention. It's not surprising that I'm seeing it for the first time now.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: And based on its contents, it's closer to a will and a chronicle than a letter. But who? The tone of the writing feels quite familiar...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It seems related to the Shinrou Casket?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Ah! Now that you mentioned it, you're right, it is from the old man who brought the Shinrou Casket. It's... it's something that happened not too long after I arrived in the bottle.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: The old man was from Inazuma. His first question upon arriving here was whether this Domain fulfills wishes, and he wanted to be sent to a battlefield of the past...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: I tried to explain it to him, but... His physical condition was terrible when he arrived, and even his mind was clearly at its limit from his arduous journey...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: He kept repeating things like "I beg you, send me back to that day" or "send me back to that war..."

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: So, I used the bottle's mirage to recreate the battlefield from his mind.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! So when he mentioned "finally returning" in the letter...

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: It's probably because when he woke up in a daze, the mirage surrounding him was already the image of the battlefield in his memories. It was quite a scary battlefield, but he had such a big smile on his face.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: Why would someone wish to see something so terrifying in their last moments?

choices.text: Maybe it means something special to him?

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: I don't know. But he looked very satisfied, in the end.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: If there was a wish he had to fulfill in a place like that, the years he spent carrying that burden must have been really hard.

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: The Shinrou Casket was a big help in restarting the Central Hub. So, I owe Mr. Hideie a debt of gratitude.

choices.text: Maybe it's more exciting that way.
Really? Let me have a look!

response.speaker: Idyia
response.text: I-It's just a metaphor. It's no different from your palm print. Nothing special, really.
